provenance.publisher: Australian Government Department of Climate Change, Energy, the Environment and Water
provenance.attribution: Collaborative Australian Protected Areas Database (CAPAD) 2024, Commonwealth of Australia 2025. Australian Government DCCEEW. Selected and generalised by AVES.
provenance.sourceCrs: GDA94 / EPSG:4283, transformed by official ArcGIS service outSR=4326
provenance.modifications: 13 selected NP/NPC records, NRS_PA=Y, environment T/B. Parcels dissolved by PA_ID. Topology-preserving simplification at at most 0.0005 degrees, rounded to 8 decimals, islands and holes retained, symmetric area change at most 2%.
provenance.limitations: Selected pilot, not national coverage. Other national parks, separate marine parks, interim areas, Indigenous Protected Areas and other reserve categories are omitted. T/B park records retain their coastal geometry. Boundaries are not entrances, current access permissions, bird occurrence or certification. Check current closures, permits and cultural restrictions with park managers.
provenance.omissionReason: The selected Daintree NP record is only a small residual parcel. A separate National Park Aboriginal record (QLD_0017DAB001) needs a combined-category review before mapping the named park.
